changes.summary: South Carolina Senator Lindsey Graham's sudden death at 71 has shocked Washington. Once a fierce critic of then-candidate Donald Trump, he became one of the president's most consistent defenders.

changes.title: Trump Sought an Iran War Exit. Putin Pushed On in Ukraine. Now Both Are Stuck.
changes.summary: The Iran and Ukraine wars underline the common limits of military force in achieving political ends, but also the differences between a dug-in Russian president and a vacillating American one.

changes.title: Hard-Liners in Iran Want to Keep Fighting America
changes.summary: With much of their leadership killed in the war, Iran’s conservatives have sought to fill the void and intensify the fight against the United States.

changes.title: Iran’s supreme leader vows revenge for father’s killing
changes.summary: Iranian state media reports that the Revolutionary Guard says the Strait of Hormuz is closed until further notice. It comes as Iran’s new supreme leader, Mojtaba Khamenei, is vowing revenge for his father’s killing, saying it is the “demand” of his country.
